usage: music-tagger genre [-h] [--add GENRE] [--remove GENRE] [--force]
                          [--list] [--artist ARTIST] [--root ROOT] [--dry-run]
                          [--log LOG | --no-log]
                          [path] [genres ...]

Set or show the genre tag on all tracks in an album directory.

positional arguments:
  path             Album directory.
  genres           Genres to set, replacing what is there. Omit to show
                   current genres.

options:
  -h, --help       show this help message and exit
  --add GENRE      Add a genre, keeping the rest.
  --remove GENRE   Remove a genre.
  --force          Allow genres that are not on the canonical list.
  --list           List all genres in the library with track counts.
  --artist ARTIST  Show the genres on each of this artist's albums in the
                   library.
  --root ROOT      Library root for --list and --artist (default:
                   /mnt/synology/media/music).
  --dry-run        Show what would change without writing.
  --log LOG        Append changes to this log file (default:
                   $MUSIC_TAGGER_LOG, else ~/Projects/music-
                   tagger/changes.log).
  --no-log         Do not write the change log.
